criteria.observations: Record normal and excitation observations for all main and case plates.
criteria.plausibility: Choose one current selection claim and one current expression claim; the debrief compares each with the curated control pattern.
criteria.evidence-limits: Record an evidence-limit explanation for each main plate and an uncertainty statement for the case.
criteria.support-status: Report whether each selected claim aligns with the control-derived support status; matching a fictional cause earns no separate credit.
